Normal.description: Normal-type Pokémon are versatile and well-balanced, relying on straightforward attacks and adaptable abilities.

Fire.description: Fire-type Pokémon specialize in powerful flame-based attacks that can overwhelm opponents with heat and intensity.

Water.description: Water-type Pokémon excel at flowing attacks, adaptability, and defensive strategies in battle.

Electric.description: Electric-type Pokémon harness lightning and electricity to strike quickly with high-speed attacks.

Grass.description: Grass-type Pokémon use nature, plants, and sunlight to recover health and control the battlefield.

Ice.description: Ice-type Pokémon freeze opponents with chilling attacks and powerful blizzards.

Fighting.description: Fighting-type Pokémon rely on physical strength, martial arts, and close-range combat techniques.

Poison.description: Poison-type Pokémon weaken opponents through toxins, venom, and lingering status effects.

Ground.description: Ground-type Pokémon command the earth with devastating earthquakes and powerful terrain-based attacks.

Flying.description: Flying-type Pokémon dominate the skies with aerial speed, agility, and wind-based techniques.

Psychic.description: Psychic-type Pokémon possess extraordinary mental abilities, telekinesis, and powerful psychic energy.

Bug.description: Bug-type Pokémon rely on speed, swarms, and unique evolutionary traits to outmaneuver opponents.

Rock.description: Rock-type Pokémon possess exceptional durability and unleash crushing attacks with stone and boulders.

Ghost.description: Ghost-type Pokémon use supernatural powers, curses, and spectral abilities to confuse their opponents.

Dragon.description: Dragon-type Pokémon are among the strongest, known for immense power, resilience, and legendary status.

Dark.description: Dark-type Pokémon specialize in cunning tactics, deception, and powerful moves that exploit opponents' weaknesses.

Steel.description: Steel-type Pokémon are incredibly resilient, boasting unmatched defenses and metallic strength.

Fairy.description: Fairy-type Pokémon wield mystical magic and charm, making them especially effective against Dragon-type Pokémon.
